verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents Workers code being written against standard, cross-platform runtime APIs so it runs unmodified on other edge platforms. The "no vendor lock-in" claim is about tooling (Git, GitHub Actions, VS Code), not runtime or storage APIs. The documented data access goes through Cloudflare-specific Bindings and KV/D1, which a community member describes as locked-in. The open-source workerd simulator is a local-testing building block, not evidence of portability across edge platforms.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write code against standard runtime APIs so it runs unmodified across multiple edge platforms instead of being locked into proprietary storage/runtime APIs
